high_level_description: This image depicts a large, modern sculpture of a winged horse, commonly known as Pegasus, perched atop a pedestal. The sculpture is made of a metallic material, possibly bronze or stainless steel, and is intricately detailed, capturing the dynamic pose of the mythical creature with its wings spread wide and legs in mid-stride. The pedestal on which the sculpture stands is rectangular and appears to be made of concrete or a similar material. There is a plaque on the left side of the pedestal that includes text, likely providing information about the monument or dedication.
